# Provider health fixture: the landing pages the daily "provider health"
# workflow resolves to prove both handlers still work. Several games are
# listed on purpose: while any link of a hoster proves the flow, that
# hoster reads ok — a hoster only goes stale when EVERY of its links died.
#
# Refresh, by hand only:
#   - only when a run goes stale: every link of that hoster died
#   - pick one or two current repacks that offer BOTH fuckingfast and
#     filekeeper, and paste one or two part links per hoster per game
#   - commit the change; it also resets GitHub's 60-day scheduled-workflow
#     keep-alive clock
#
# Format: one landing page URL per line; "#" comments and blank lines are
# ignored, markdown links work too.
